behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Assert generic error order/identity, falsey errors and first-only short circuit.
Assert legacy first field error and new full errors with accepted/boundary records unchanged.
docDelivery: Explain collector pass/error values, order, short circuit and thrown errors.
Document shared record rule order, local grammar and first/all API behavior.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Ordered synchronous rule collection with nullish pass/falsy errors; fixed local record rules and immutable inputs.
manualBehavior: Verify both record APIs share one ordered rule set and collectErrors; validate must request actual first-error short circuit, not evaluate all then select first.
independence: Refactor fail-fast validation into reusable collection helper with legacy fail-fast wrapper and new all-errors API.
